name: browserbase
purpose: Hosted browser automation. Use for authenticated LinkedIn People tab + DM threads + Substack publishing.
required_for_career: optional — without it, LinkedIn People tab + DM threads won't work. Public profile reads still work via linkedin-community.
preferred_browser_for_setup: playwright (anonymous — we navigate to browserbase.com to get the customer's keys)

steps.prompt: Sign up for browserbase (FREE Hobby tier likely sufficient for typical use). Press ENTER when at the dashboard.

steps.instruction: Navigate to Settings → API Keys (or the API section)
Extract the Project ID (usually visible on the dashboard or in project settings)

manual_install: From the dashboard, go to API Keys, generate one, copy it
From project settings, copy the Project ID
